objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object representing a policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, or other controlled document within the system, subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The classification of the document indicating its level and purpose (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: A short code prefix used in the document name to identify its type (e.g., RL for guideline).

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: A cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number assigned per document type, included in the document name.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The descriptive title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle state of the document (e.g., Editing, Released, Out of Force, Archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the document, incremented upon content or relevant attribute changes.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which the released document version is considered valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The calculated date until which the document remains valid, derived from Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The defined time period for which a document is valid before a validity extension check is required (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The defined period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: The language in which the document was originally created.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other related documents or master data objects referenced by the document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications associated with or referenced by the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational entities for which the document is relevant.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Scopes or areas to which the document applies.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: The person designated as the primary author responsible for the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons assigned personal change rights on the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check the document for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) responsible for approving and releasing the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment controlling which readers may view the document.

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to translate released document content into other languages.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of in which clients of a multi-client system the document is visible.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is automatically released with the release of the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the attachment, tracked independently but following the main document's release cycle.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle state of the attachment, passing through all statuses of the main document's release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not have its own release cycle; released directly via switches in properties.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The publication state of the additional information, controlled directly via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by an author to suggest changes to an existing released document, managed without affecting the document's current content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current processing state of the change proposal (e.g., created, scheduled, completed).

attributes.name: editing_notes
attributes.description: Documentation by the author of the underlying document on how the change proposal was handled.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined group of users used to assign read or change authorizations and distribution roles for documents.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The identifying name of the user group.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: The classification of the user group (e.g., Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: person
objs.description: An individual user in the system who can be assigned roles and authorizations on documents.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the person.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: The license role assigned to the person (e.g., READER, AUTHOR).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A configurable list of user groups and persons assigned to a document to receive notifications upon release, either by email or for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: The type of distribution: by email notification or for active acknowledgement confirmation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise the document's validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The processing state of the validity extension request.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request created to invalidate a released document and archive it, withdrawing it from circulation when it no longer has validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The processing state of the override (out-of-force) request.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring its status and authorizations.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The processing state of the reactivation request.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: A configurable classification defining the category and level of a document, with associated templates, abbreviations, validity periods, and archive durations.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the document type (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of the document type within the document pyramid (1-4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: The type abbreviation used in document naming conventions.

attributes.name: default_validity_period
attributes.description: The default period of extended validity defined for this document type.

attributes.name: default_archive_duration
attributes.description: The default archive retention period defined for this document type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects, supporting standard MS Office formats and TAG technology for metadata insertion.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the document template.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The file format of the template (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process controlling the approval, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement steps for documents.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: The type of workflow (e.g., Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Acknowledgement, Translation Release).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the workflow execution.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A documented signature captured from workflow participants during approval steps, recorded per released version for traceability.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The person who provided the electronic signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the signature was applied.

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The step in the workflow at which the signature was provided (e.g., Creator, Review, Release).

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A record of a person's active confirmation of having read and noted a released document version, triggered through distribution for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

attributes.name: person
attributes.description: The person who is required to or has confirmed acknowledgement.

attributes.name: document_version
attributes.description: The version of the document for which acknowledgement is requested.

objs.name: report
objs.description: A predefined evaluation or search function providing filtered results based on selection parameters, available in role-specific variants.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the report (e.g., Status Report: Documents & Instruction, Search for Documents & Instructions).

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The role for which the report is available (e.g., Reader, Author).

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: The configurable filter criteria used to influence evaluation results.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document information object is created in the system by attaching a new object with selection of the corresponding document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen at the time of creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The document template selected for the new document, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: The metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated through the properties editing dialog.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the implemented editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF after saving, and the current version is displayed on the web.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release workflow (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author for a document.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first Creator step of the release workflow using an electronic signature.

evts.name: complete_review_step
evts.description: A reviewer completes the review task in the release workflow, either positively or by rejection, with an electronic signature.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Whether the review was approved or rejected.

evts.name: complete_release_step
evts.description: A releaser completes the release task in the release workflow, either positively or by rejection, with an electronic signature.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Whether the release was approved or rejected.

evts.name: reject_workflow
evts.description: The release workflow is canceled for all subsequent participants immediately after the first rejection during review or release.

attributes.name: rejected_at_step
attributes.description: The workflow step at which the rejection occurred (Review or Release).

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: The document is finally released and automatically published, becoming visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is automatically created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes, or scheduled change proposals.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: The reason for new version creation (e.g., content change, attribute change, attachment change, change proposal scheduled).

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment object is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: release_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is automatically released together with the release of its main document.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: A new additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document's version.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is released and published directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is directly deleted due to its lack of criticality, without affecting the main document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: notify_author_of_change_proposal
evts.description: The author of the underlying document is informed by e-mail about a newly created change proposal.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: document_change_proposal_editing
evts.description: The author documents the handling of an assigned change proposal directly in the change proposal object.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is marked as completed and is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before a document's validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The request for validity extension is processed through a workflow, resulting in extension of the document's validity.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document's validity (Valid Until date) is updated by the default period upon confirmation of the validity extension.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The request for validity extension is deleted after the validity has been extended or a new version has been released.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a released document and archive it.

evts.name: start_override_workflow
evts.description: The workflow for processing the override request is started automatically after creation of the request.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The last valid released version of the document is given the status Out of Force; existing edited versions are deleted and all rights except for the archive group are revoked.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is archived, withdrawing authorizations for all users except the archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period has expired, the document is physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: The workflow for processing the reactivation request is started automatically after creation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms the reactivation in the workflow step, resulting in creation of a new version with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: The invalidated document is re-validated: a new version is created, metadata is restored, authorizations are reset, distribution lists are confirmed, and archived attachments are reactivated.

evts.name: assign_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are assigned to a document's distribution list for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Whether the assignment is for email distribution or for acknowledgement.

evts.name: send_release_notification_email
evts.description: Upon release, an email notification is sent to all users and user groups assigned to the distribution by email list.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release, persons and users of assigned user groups in the acknowledgement distribution list are requested by email to confirm acknowledgement.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A person actively confirms acknowledgement of having read and noted a released document version via a workflow-supported task.

evts.name: notify_all_acknowledgements_confirmed
evts.description: The author team receives a notification when all persons in the distribution list have confirmed acknowledgement of the current version.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by an assigned translator.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is being translated.

evts.name: start_translation_release_workflow
evts.description: The approval workflow for the translated version of a document is initiated, consisting of review and release steps.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version of a document is released and becomes visible to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a specific document through property editing.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: The type of authorization assigned (e.g., read, write).

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Authorizations for a document are revoked at user group and person level, typically during archiving or override.

o2o.description: Each document belongs to a specific document type that defines its classification and level.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
An attachment is a controlled sub-document that belongs to a main document.
Additional information is a supplementary attachment that belongs to a main document.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document and is displayed within that document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document whose validity must be checked.
A request for override is created for a specific released document to invalidate it.
A request for reactivation references the specific invalidated document to be reactivated.
A distribution list is maintained per document, defining who receives notifications upon release.
User groups are assigned to a distribution list to receive notifications or acknowledgement requests.
Individual persons can be directly assigned to a distribution list.
A person can be a member of one or more user groups that define their authorizations.
Electronic signatures are captured from workflow participants during workflow steps.
Documents can reference other related documents via the references attribute.
An acknowledgement record is associated with a specific document version.
An acknowledgement is associated with the person who must confirm or has confirmed it.
